title: [v2.8.2.1-dev-d] Overview and Treatment tab not updated with TBR
symptom: In version 2.8.2.1-dev-d, the Overview and Treatment tabs stop updating with TBR records. The loop continues to work and sets 0% TBRs, but these are not displayed in the tabs. Manual TBRs from the action tab are also not shown. Restarting AAPS, rebooting the phone, and synchronizing the pump do not resolve the issue. Downgrading to a previous version (2.8.2.1-dev) and then updating back to dev-d temporarily fixes it.
cause: The regression appeared between dev-c (OK) of March 01 and dev-d (KO) of March 17, likely related to the Insight driver update.
fix: The issue was fixed by an update to the Insight driver and database.
evidence_quote: Fixed by Insight driver and database
